evidence_ids: The kit gate reports only stable check identities that ran in build and existing-kit modes, and every planted-defect control changes one measured condition, fails at its named identity, and fails itself when that check is disabled.
The Node binding test script runs the kit controls on every supported Node version without a CI-workflow edit.
A format-3 identity includes identity.json in checksums.sha256 and writes the outside-list SHA-256 of that list in kit-digest.sha256, while format 2 is refused by name.

A disposable clean clone produces a distributable kit whose artifacts and checksum list match the verification kit, and controls reject a dirty tree, attributes, filters, line endings, umask variation, and non-regular files.
Receiver probes prove it reads an in-bound body before answering and, after the bound, answers, closes, and reads nothing more for 401, 413, wrong-path, and method cases.
A structurally valid SDK-invalid event is rejected before ingress admission, its corrected same-identity event is admitted, and strict Bearer, 404, 405 Allow: POST, and client-abort controls pass.
The gate type-checks every answer-key fix and detects each fix code and expected code-and-path pair in every kit file and packed-artifact text entry.

Controls prove case-insensitive fenced-language handling, runnable blocks, identifier resolution, planned-feature markers, shipped-setting warnings, and non-synthetic document or example values fail at their named checks.

Fetch-adapter and HTTP-sink probes map reset, short-body, and malformed-chunk read errors other than a deadline to transport_failure, preserve deadline and malformed-acknowledgment behavior, and show the existing delivery retry redelivers the unchanged occurrence.
The scope-inventory and HTTP-audit-sink mutation controls remain pinned to the governed fetch-adapter source.
The fold replaces exactly the five complete canonical requirement blocks after all implementation tickets, with each retained scenario and heading unique and no delta header or contradictory SHALL.
An archive pull request follows the completed fold, moves the active change without a canonical write, and leaves the archive task unchecked until that separate work is ready.
